data.name: Baheen
data.gender_notes: Baheen is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Baheen is derived from the Arabic root 'B-H-N', which means 'to shine', 'to radiate', or 'to be bright'. In the Islamic context, Baheen can symbolize the inner light and spiritual brilliance of an individual. The name Baheen carries the meaning “Radiant, Shining” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Baheen usually hope their child will grow to embody radiant, shining and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name signifying inner light and divine brilliance.
data.etymology: Baheen belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Radiant, Shining.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Baheen total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

historical_references.reference: The name Baheen is believed to have originated from the village of Baheen in present-day Iraq, which was a significant center of Islamic scholarship during the Abbasid Caliphate (750-1258 CE). Many prominent scholars, including Al-Jahiz, were born and raised in this village, which contributed significantly to the development of Islamic thought and literature.

Another reference suggests that the name Baheen may have been given to a famous scholar named Al-Baqir Al-Baheeni, who lived during the early Abbasid period (8th century CE). He was a renowned scholar of Hadith and Fiqh and was known for his extensive knowledge and teaching abilities.
historical_references.context: Renowned scholar of Hadith and Fiqh
